review.scope: Australian Treasury 2026 IGR publication and conditional official projection model; no current-state/Forecast admission.

what_happened.summary: Treasury published its seventh IGR on21 September2026, extending the economic and Commonwealth budget projection to2065-66 with structural-transition and intergenerational-equity chapters.

what_was_expected.summary: 2023 is a prior official projection baseline, not a market pre-release expectation. No clean pre-publication benchmark established.

what_surprised.summary: Model and horizon revisions belong to projection comparison, not an event surprise.

what_appears_connected.summary: Treasury model dependencies and policy premises are conditional; ministerial reform attribution is framing, not independently proven causal magnitude.

what_may_be_noise.summary: Promotional government framing, cyclical fluctuations extrapolated40years, maintained policy confused with implementation, and central headlines stripped of sensitivities.

alternative_explanations.summary: Lower projected payments may reflect changed methods and maintained reform premises, not already realised efficiency.
Weak measured productivity can reflect cyclical capital/measurement effects, not necessarily permanent failure of the long-run rate.
Period fertility decline may partly reflect delay, not equivalent completed-cohort decline.

second_order_effects.summary: Projected fiscal/distribution/sector effects are not observed outcomes.

falsifiers.summary: Review if multi-year underlying estimates fail the stated transition or revisions alter trend; a single weak quarter is not a 40-year falsifier.
Revise use if sustained age-specific/cohort evidence fails assumed recovery or terminal path; never from one registration-year fluctuation.
Review if a durable visa/border regime or multi-year measured flows invalidate convergence, not from one quarterly release.
Review after sustained cohort-pattern departures or structural survey/model changes; preserve original comparison vintage.
Review when measured gains or labour/distribution effects materially diverge from assumed diffusion/complementary channels.
Review on persistent delivery/cost divergence or new damage-model evidence; do not replace assumptions with aspirational targets.
Review on persistent adjusted cost divergence, accounting change or morbidity shift affecting program models.
Review on actuarial revision, reform reversal/non-delivery or material mix/cost departures.
Review when enacted settings or sustained tax-base change invalidate maintained ceiling or compensating-policy assumptions.

limitations: DRAFT native event-review spine plus separate extension candidate; production admission and public projection prohibited.
